ideas.pitch: A gamified micro-savings and investment education app targeted at college students with localized UPI integration and visual budgeting nodes.
ideas.title: AuraFin
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses heavily on UI/UX and visual design, which is a primary judging criterion for GDG KalaKriti.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered document parser and appeal generator designed to prevent wrongful health insurance claim rejections in India.
ideas.title: MediClaim Assist
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the architectural pattern of enterprise agents fighting insurance denials seen in winning healthtech hackathon projects.

ideas.pitch: A hyper-local sustainability dashboard tracking real-time urban air quality and commuting carbon footprints for Mumbai neighborhoods.
ideas.title: EcoPulse Mumbai
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles the Sustainability and Smart Cities design domain using practical data visualization tailored to local urban challenges.

ideas.pitch: A meal planning and nutrition assistant optimized for Indian college student hostel mess menus and local grocery availability.
ideas.title: NutriMeal AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts proven nutrition platform mechanics into a hyper-localized context that judges will immediately relate to.

ideas.pitch: An IoT-enabled waste management monitoring interface that optimizes municipal garbage collection routes dynamically.
ideas.title: SmartBin Network
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses Smart Cities infrastructure using clear status dashboards and simulated sensor streams which excel in short-duration designathons.
